I replied to Pree in the #central-team thread. I couldn't confirm or rule out the 8 April date, so I didn't record it anywhere and the tip stays unverified.

- **Nothing to check against:** The shared files have no Brackenwater folder, and none of the channels Pree belongs to discuss the account. The company knowledge base may hold more, but I didn't use anything Pree couldn't see herself.
- **Owner:** Brackenwater Freight Co. is a North team account. Notes everyone can read say it moved to Marcus Lindqvist on 15 Sept 2025.
- **Next step:** I suggested Pree pass the tip to Marcus as secondhand so he can check it against the contract. I offered to send it to him for her; nothing has gone to him yet.

My reply's wording came out a bit awkward. It says Pree "can't see any Brackenwater contract or renewal record, so I won't check one for you." The meaning is right, but it reads less smoothly than I'd like.
